cass-tullibee-refuge-lakes.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon
cass-tullibee-refuge-lakes.geojson.caveats: Tullibee (Cisco) Refuge Lakes -- sublayer of the Refuge group layer 0 (not queryable). The refuge itself has no polygon of its own; it is defined by its lakes (this layer) and its upstream minors. DOW numbers join to the viewer's lakes layer.
